toegepas.voor: die temperatuur hoër en die dae
toegepas.na: die temperatuur hoër, en die dae
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb (temperatuur is / dae is).
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses (die temperatuur is hoer / die dae is langer).
toegepas.rede_keurder: Both halves have their own subject and verb, so the AWS 2017 requires the comma.

toegepas.rede_vinder: Afrikaans normally uses the expletive 'daar' with an indefinite subject like 'reën' in this clause.
toegepas.fout: Indefinite subject 'reen' without the expletive 'daar' reads stiff in the clause.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'hoeveel reen daar gewoonlik val' is the natural Afrikaans form and the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.na: val daar reën deur die jaar
toegepas.rede_vinder: The indefinite subject 'reën' after the verb reads more naturally with 'daar'.
toegepas.fout: Inverted indefinite subject 'reen' without 'daar' reads unnatural.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'val daar reen deur die jaar' is the natural construction and says the same thing.
